name: universal-agent-harness-builder
description: Build a project-aware, token-efficient coding-agent harness for Codex, Antigravity, and Claude Code, with shared project context and platform adapters.

interface.longDescription: Analyze an existing or new software repository and create shared project context plus a Codex adapter. The same repository also ships Antigravity and Claude Code adapters. Existing files are preserved outside managed blocks.
